'''Joshua Christian Kojo King''' (born 15 January 1992) is a Norwegian professional [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Forward (association football)#Centre-forward|forward]] or [[left winger]] for Saudi club [[Al-Khaleej FC|Al-Khaleej]].

King was signed by [[Manchester United]] from [[Vålerenga Fotball|Vålerenga]] in 2008. After loan spells with [[Preston North End F.C.|Preston North End]], [[Borussia Mönchengladbach]], [[Hull City A.F.C.|Hull City]] and [[Blackburn Rovers F.C.|Blackburn Rovers]], he signed permanently with Blackburn in January 2013, before switching to [[AFC Bournemouth]] in May 2015. In February 2021, in a deadline day deal, he returned to the top flight with a move to [[Everton F.C.|Everton]].

After representing [[Norway national football team|Norway]] at under-15, under-16, under-18, [[Norway national under-19 football team|under-19]] and [[Norway national under-21 football team|under-21]] levels, King made his senior international debut against [[Iceland national football team|Iceland]] in 2012, and scored his first international goal against [[Cyprus national football team|Cyprus]] later that year.
